name: 49721 · Cheboygan, MI
findings: ZIP 49721 (Cheboygan) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49721 (Cheboygan) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 49721 (Cheboygan) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.
